summary: Iter 23 — Blog + Email newsletter + SEO (sitemap.xml / llms.txt / robots.txt). Backend pytest: 22/22 PASS — public GET /api/blog returns {total,items}, GET /api/blog/{bad-slug} → 404, admin GET/PUT /api/admin/blog/config (pause + schedule_hours_utc + auto_share), POST /api/admin/blog/run-now actually invokes Emergent LLM (Claude for text + Gemini Nano Banana for image) and watermarks the hero in ~30s — returned post is in the public list, GET by slug works, PUT to status=draft hides it from public, title update regenerates slug, DELETE removes it. POST /api/subscribe (no auth) — new returns already_subscribed=false, repeat returns true, invalid email → 422. GET /api/unsubscribe?token=BAD → HTML 'Link expired'; with valid token from admin /subscribers list → flips to 'unsubscribed' (verified by re-fetching the row). GET /api/admin/subscribers + /stats + send-now batch (no RESEND_API_KEY → sent=0, queued matches sub count). SEO: /api/sitemap.xml (XML, includes /about /contact /terms /privacy /blog), /api/llms.txt (text/plain, contains 'Lumo'), /api/robots.txt (Disallow /admin + Sitemap + AI bots GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended), static /llms.txt root file OK. Frontend E2E: admin login → /admin → 'admin-tab-blog' tab opens BlogAdmin with both sub-tabs (blog-admin-sub-blog + blog-admin-sub-newsletter), blog-status-panel + blog-run-now visible, newsletter-tiles render on newsletter sub-tab. Landing renders home-subscribe-section + subscribe-form-card; submitting an email shows subscribe-success. /blog renders blog-index-page; /blog/nonexistent-slug-xyz shows blog-post-not-found; SiteFooter footer-link-blog → /blog visible.
critical_code_review_comments: blog.py:watermark — clean PIL implementation, safe fallback to original bytes on any failure. Pad+chip combo guarantees logo legibility on busy hero images.
blog.py:_publish_one — recent-topic avoidance (last 6) prevents rotation collapse; if all topics recent, falls back to full catalog. Good.
blog.py:_save_image — tries server.put_object first then local /app/backend/storage/blog fallback. Both paths are served (server.py L2037 has /blog-image/{filename}).
blog.py:_loop — window-key logic (`<date>_<hour>`) correctly prevents double-publishing within the same 30-min window even across loop restarts.
email_subs.py:_send_email — gracefully degrades when RESEND_API_KEY missing (returns 'no_api_key' info string, which _run_one records as queued_only=true). No exception path crashes the batch.
email_subs.py:subscribe — lowercases email + uses secrets.token_urlsafe(24) for unsub token. EmailStr validation via pydantic returns 422 for bad input (verified).
email_subs.py:unsubscribe — always returns 200 HTML (good UX); 'Link expired' for bad tokens vs success for matched. No info leak.
server.py /api/sitemap.xml — pulls published blog posts and emits <url><loc>…/blog/{slug}</loc></url> entries; verified by integration. Content-Type xml.
server.py /api/robots.txt — includes explicit Allow rules for GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/Google-Extended (AI-crawler welcome) + Disallow /admin + Sitemap reference. Good SEO hygiene.
Static /llms.txt at /app/frontend/public/llms.txt is served at root via CRA static; backend /api/llms.txt is dynamic with current blog count — both endpoints coexist as designed.

BlogAdmin.jsx — sub-tab pattern (blog-admin-sub-blog / blog-admin-sub-newsletter) with shared parent data-testid='blog-admin-page' makes E2E navigation trivial. Run-now button correctly disables while busy.

EmailSubscribeForm.jsx — exposes both 'card' and 'inline' variants under the same data-testid scheme (subscribe-email-input / subscribe-submit), and replaces form with subscribe-success on success. Used on Landing 'home-subscribe-section'.
test_credentials: admin@lumo.test / password123 (also customer@lumo.test, provider@lumo.test — not used here)
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_iter23_<ts>@example.com subscriber rows (some active, one unsubscribed) and the run-now blog post was deleted in the same test class. The post created by /api/admin/blog/run-now produced a real watermarked hero image via Nano Banana; cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog router mounted with create_router(db, require_admin) → routes: GET /api/blog (public {total,items}, status=published only, excludes body_md in list), GET /api/blog/{slug}, GET+PUT /api/admin/blog/config (paused, schedule_hours_utc [9,17], auto_share, topics catalog of 6, last_run_at, last_window_key), GET /api/admin/blog (admin list including drafts), POST /api/admin/blog/run-now (real LLM call ~25-40s — Claude for body + Gemini Nano Banana for hero, watermarked via PIL with /app/frontend/public/logo192.png at bottom-right), PUT /api/admin/blog/{id} (title→slug regen, excerpt, body_md, tags[≤8], status published|draft), DELETE /api/admin/blog/{id}. Email subs router: POST /api/subscribe (public, pydantic EmailStr 422 on bad), GET /api/unsubscribe?token=… (HTMLResponse 200 either way), admin GET /api/admin/subscribers (q regex+i case-insensitive, status filter), GET /api/admin/subscribers/stats {active,unsubscribed,total_sends,last_send_at,resend_configured}, POST /api/admin/subscribers/send-now (without RESEND_API_KEY → sent=0, queued=#active, batch_id stamped, records in email_sends). SEO: /api/sitemap.xml dynamic (landing+core+published blog posts), /api/llms.txt dynamic (Lumo summary + blog count), /api/robots.txt (Disallow /admin + AI bot allows + Sitemap). Frontend testids verified: admin-tab-blog, blog-admin-page, blog-admin-sub-{blog,newsletter}, blog-status-panel, blog-run-now, blog-toggle-pause, blog-post-list, blog-post-row-{slug}, newsletter-tiles, newsletter-send-now, sub-row-{email}, subscribe-form-card, subscribe-form-inline, subscribe-email-input, subscribe-submit, subscribe-success, home-subscribe-section, blog-index-page, blog-card-{slug}, blog-post-page, blog-post-not-found, footer-link-blog. Test note: in /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_blog_email_seo.py the test_email is lowercase because backend lowercases on insert.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. One initial test failure (TestEmailSubs.test_list_subscribers) was a test-harness defect: backend lowercases emails on insert so the stored value didn't match the uppercase TEST_ prefix the test was comparing against. Fixed by using lowercase prefix in the test fixture.
